sourceSearch.priority: Manufacturer CAD, then manufacturer dimensioned photographs
sourceSearch.scope: Pinned official product resources and manufacturer repository tree inspected; see S3 source manifests.
sourceSearch.candidateCadAssessment: Official G product links a ZIP whose STEP/PDF are named non-G ESP32-S3-ePaper-1.54. The PDF outer39.8x53x16.9mm matches the current G photo, but prints27mm AA vs27.8mm optical window and no proof of updated G PCB equivalence. Native CAD is retained as a candidate, not silently treated as current G internal layout.

limitations: Exact optional battery/internal PCB arrangement, hidden connectors and detailed casing are UNKNOWN. The neutral PCB layer is an estimated viewing reference, not fabricated circuitry.
No electrical mating connector or physical key position is declared without a corresponding calibrated source. Catalog GPIO input controls remain separate.
Original source photo is clipped outside the live screen. Unknown glass-to-PCB orientation is not proven by the geometric screen placement.

The sourced candidate STEP is not inserted: its non-G board revision identity is unresolved. The27.8mm optical aperture is from the current G dimension photograph; candidate PDF27mm AA is retained as a separate reference.

screen.basis: Manufacturer dimensioned optical opening; source photograph registers its center with about1.5mm uncertainty. Opening is not substituted for an independently unestablished active-area border.

inspectionGroups.notes: Illustrative inspection separation to expose the UNKNOWN PCB layer. The displacement is a debugging arrangement, not a claimed mechanical assembly axis or travel.

derivedParts.basis: UNKNOWN internal PCB reference. All dimensions/thickness/location are explicit conservative viewing estimates within the documented envelope, not board CAD or measured PCB facts.

photoRegistration.method: Front-face pixel bounds registered to the printed manufacturer dimension; source image is unchanged.
